name: Telegram Bot Integration
description: Multilingual Telegram bot with menus, notifications, node reports, and reseller tools.
author: ZaoGuang Service

enable_ticket_notify.label: Enable ticket notifications
enable_ticket_notify.description: Send new tickets and customer replies to administrators and staff.

enable_payment_notify.label: Enable payment notifications
enable_payment_notify.description: Send successful payment notifications to administrators and staff.

enable_node_group_report.label: Send scheduled node reports to a group
enable_node_group_report.description: Send fresh node status and online-user telemetry on an independent Laravel schedule. The /setreportgroup command remains a fallback when no destination is configured below.

node_report_chat_id.label: Node report Telegram chat ID
node_report_chat_id.description: Positive private-chat ID or negative group/supergroup ID. A configured value takes precedence over /setreportgroup.

node_report_locale.label: Node report language
node_report_locale.description: Language used by scheduled node reports.

enable_daily_business_report.label: Send a daily commercial summary
enable_daily_business_report.description: After midnight in Vietnam, send the completed previous day's traffic, sales, revenue, coupon, node and user rankings to a protected destination.

daily_business_report_time.label: Daily commercial report time
daily_business_report_time.description: Vietnam time (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh) in HH:MM format. The report always summarizes the completed previous Vietnam calendar day.

daily_business_report_chat_id.label: Daily commercial report Chat ID
daily_business_report_chat_id.description: Private administrator chat or trusted group that may receive revenue and masked user rankings. Telegram group IDs are normally negative.

daily_business_report_reuse_node_group.label: Reuse the node report group
daily_business_report_reuse_node_group.description: Explicitly allow commercial data to be sent to the node report group when no separate commercial Chat ID is configured.

enable_database_backup.label: Send automatic database backups through Telegram
enable_database_backup.description: Create, compress, and encrypt a database backup daily, then send it to the private chat selected with /setbackupchat.

database_backup_chat_id.label: Backup destination chat ID (optional)
database_backup_chat_id.description: Leave blank and send /setbackupchat to the bot in a private chat.

database_backup_password.label: Backup encryption password
database_backup_password.description: At least 16 characters. Prefer TELEGRAM_DATABASE_BACKUP_PASSWORD in .env instead of saving it here.

database_backup_max_mb.label: Maximum backup size
database_backup_max_mb.description: Stop and report an error if the backup exceeds the selected limit.

enable_reseller_bot.label: Enable reseller tools
enable_reseller_bot.description: Allow only bound users explicitly marked with is_reseller to manage their referred customers using a valid 100% coupon. Administrator and staff roles do not grant reseller access.
